findings.evidence: PDF p. 164: "Its projection proxy is 2 × 7B × 2,048 = 28.672 TFLOP. A simplified output-only AR counter evaluates 256 positions and gives 3.584 TFLOP. The block example has one quarter as many sequential evaluations but eight times as much output-side projection work. These are different quantities, not contradictory results. [ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION][DERIVED] This arithmetic omits prompt encoding, context attention, block-finalization encoding, the output head, refresh, classifier-free guidance, verification and communication."
findings.issue: A three-tag label [ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION][DERIVED] appears where the Preface specifies a two-tag pair: 'A label pair always takes one item from each of the first two axes, e.g. [1P][FACT], [canonical scenario][DERIVED], [ILLUSTRATIVE][ASSUMPTION], with Axis 3 riding along. ... The two tags are set with no space between them'. ASSUMPTION and DERIVED are both Axis-2 values and are mutually exclusive, so the triple tag is not a legal label. Recurrence sweep: this is the only triple-tag instance across PDF pp. 1–179; every other tag in that range is a legal pair, a bare Axis-2 tag (see F-05), or a bare Axis-3 tag.
findings.fix_instruction: Reduce to a legal pair. The worked example's inputs are chosen and its results computed, so [ILLUSTRATIVE][DERIVED] is the correct pair; drop the middle [ASSUMPTION].

findings.evidence: Ch 8, PDF p. 173: "The utilization-only (ρ = 1, no 95% N+1 term) screen is total = ⌈N ÷ 0.7⌉ — 30 for KV-only, 32 for case (ii) — and is reported as a floor, not a deployment count." | Ch 4, PDF p. 103: "the book's provisioning policy, which multiplies the independent ρ = 0.95 as well and then adds the N−1 reserve"
findings.issue: ρ is used for two different factors in the fleet-sizing rule: Ch 4 assigns ρ = 0.95 to the availability/utilization derating and calls the 0.70 the 'u' target, while Ch 8 writes '(ρ = 1, no 95% N+1 term)' — using ρ = 1 to mean 'the 0.95 factor omitted' while simultaneously applying 0.7. Ch 8 also bundles '95%' and 'N+1' into one phrase, although Ch 8's own policy sentence two paragraphs earlier separates them: 'total = ⌈N ÷ (0.7 × 0.95)⌉ ... and working = total − 1 (one host held for failure reserve)'. The spare is '+1 host', not 'N+1', and it is not the same term as the 95% factor.
findings.fix_instruction: Use one symbol per factor across both chapters (e.g. u = 0.70 utilization target, ρ = 0.95 availability derating, plus a separate '+1 spare'), and rewrite the Ch 8 clause as 'the utilization-only screen (no ρ derating, no spare) is total = ⌈N ÷ 0.7⌉'.
